description: This file provides functions to retrieve theme tokens from CSS variables, toggle between dark and light themes, and initialize the theme based on stored preferences or system settings. It manages theme-related state and exposes an interface for theme manipulation in a web application.

methods.name: getThemeTokens()
methods.description: Returns the current computed CSS custom properties as a JavaScript object for theme-related colors and styles.

methods.name: toggleTheme()
methods.description: Switches between 'light' and 'dark' themes by updating the data-theme attribute on the document element and saving the preference in local storage.

methods.name: initTheme()
methods.description: Initializes the theme based on saved user preferences or system preferences, setting the document's data-theme attribute accordingly.
